title: Software Asset Management (SAM) Program Standup & Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (program/governance: SAM lifecycle, SOPs, KPIs, roles, ITIL v4 alignment across tools and stakeholders).
hook: Stand up a real Software Asset Management program — not just a spreadsheet
problem: Most organizations 'do SAM' as scattered spreadsheets and last-minute audit panic. There is no defined lifecycle, no owners, no KPIs, and no repeatable process — so compliance is luck and savings are left on the table. This solution stands up a real Software Asset Management program: the SAM lifecycle, roles and RACI, SOPs and workflows, KPIs, and ITIL v4 alignment, so software is governed deliberately from request to retirement.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the SAM lifecycle (request → entitlement → deployment → reconciliation → renewal/retirement), roles and RACI, the tooling landscape, and ITIL v4 alignment.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (an entitlement system of record, discovery data, a request/intake channel, named owners, executive sponsorship) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define scope and roles, stand up the system of record and intake, author SOPs and workflows, set KPIs and reporting, run the first governance cycle, then pilot, validate, and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — SAM-readiness discovery, process/data-coverage validation, a SAM KPI and maturity report, safe remediation of data gaps, and a SAM-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Stand up a real Software Asset Management program — the SAM lifecycle, roles and RACI, SOPs and workflows, KPIs, and ITIL v4 alignment, so software is governed from request to retirement. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
